Startup.Title: PZ Mod Inspector
Startup.GameNotFound: Project Zomboid is not installed with Steam. PZ Mod Inspector needs the game installed and closes.
Startup.VersionUnreadable: Cannot read the game version from {0}. PZ Mod Inspector needs it and closes.
Startup.VersionTooOld: The installed Project Zomboid is version {0}: PZ Mod Inspector works only with Build 42 or later and closes.
Startup.CustomSteam: The Steam folder is set by hand ({0}): if it is wrong, remove SteamDirectory from {1}.
Startup.NoApiKey.Title: Steam Web API key missing
Startup.NoApiKey:
No Steam Web API key is set: without a key the dependencies between mods (the items they require on the Workshop) cannot be checked, so the information will be partial.

Press OK to open the settings and enter the key.
Toolbar.Reload.Tip: Reads installed mods, saves and game version again
Toolbar.RefreshWorkshop.Tip: Asks Steam right now for dates and state of every mod (use sparingly so as not to risk a Steam ban)
Source.DefaultHint: Zomboid\mods\default.txt: mods loaded at the main menu
Filter.Label: Filter
Filter.Search: Search name, ID, author or Workshop ID…
Summary: {0} mods in list · {1} loaded · {2} errors · {3} warnings
Column.Name: Mod name
Column.Status.Tip: Green: no problems; yellow: warnings; red: errors. The tooltip of the dot shows the main problem.
Column.LoadIndex.Tip: Position in the order the game really loads the mods: every mod comes after the ones it requires (require=), even when they are further down in the file. Empty when the game does not load it.
Column.ListIndex.Tip: Position in the list file (the save's mods.txt or default.txt). Empty for mods that are not in the list but that the game loads because another mod requires them.
Column.Name.Tip: Name of the mod (name= in mod.info); for mods that are not installed, the one known from the Workshop or other sources.
Column.Id.Tip: ID of the mod (id= in mod.info): the one written in the mod list.
Column.Version.Tip: Version declared by the author (modversion= in mod.info).
Column.Updated.Tip: Date of the last update on the Workshop; without Workshop data, that of the copy downloaded by Steam.
Column.WorkshopId.Tip: Number of the item on the Steam Workshop.
Column.WorkshopTitle.Tip: Title of the Workshop page: it can differ from the name in mod.info, and one Workshop item can contain several mods.
Column.Problems.Tip: The most serious problem of the mod (warning or error). The full list is in the details and in the Problems tab.
Details.Close: Close the details (they open again when a mod is selected)
Details.Empty: Select a mod to see its details.
Details.Copies: Other folders with the same ID (ignored)
Files.Lost: Files overwritten by mods loaded later ({0})
Files.Won: Files of other mods this one overwrites ({0})
Files.ReplacedSame: overwritten by an equal copy (at most comments and spaces differ)
Files.Merged: read together with the other copies
Files.Unused: the game does not read it
Files.NoneRead: none (the game does not read the file)
Files.InGame: The base game has it too: the mods overwrite it.
Info.Name: Name
Info.Author: Author
Ignored.Hint: Mod folders the game skips: nearly always mods for earlier versions of the game or with an invalid mod.info. If the Workshop item does not also contain valid mods, you can probably unsubscribe from it on the Workshop.
Ignored.Column.Name: Mod
Ignored.ItemHasMods: the item also has valid mods: do not unsubscribe
Conflicts.Hint: Only different copies and translations with redefined texts. Double-click: the mod of the copy used, or the overwritten one on its column.
Diff.Button.Tip: Compares the copies with the program set (the older on the left); with more than two copies you choose which
Diff.Pick.Title: Choose the copies to compare
Diff.Pick.Hint: Tick two copies, in load order: the first goes on the left. Hover a copy for its path.
FileSearch.Search: Name, path or pattern with * and ? (e.g. *tuning*.lua)…
FileSearch.Hint: Every file of the loaded mods, not only the overwritten ones. Hover a row for the paths, double click to select the mod of the copy used (or the overwritten one, on its column).
FileSearch.Limited: Files found: {0}, showing the first {1}: narrow the search.
FileSearch.None: No file of the loaded mods matches "{0}".
Log.Reload.Tip: Reads the file from disk again, for example after playing
Log.Choose.Tip: Opens another log, for example one in Zomboid\Logs
Log.ShowFile: Show the file in File Explorer
Log.Summary: · modified {0} · {1} errors and {2} warnings in {3} groups · {4} linked to mods
Log.Empty: No errors or warnings in this log.

Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.Paths.Hint: Leave empty to use automatic detection.
Settings.ApiKey.Hint: Needed for the items mods require on the Workshop: Steam returns them only with a key. The key is free (localhost works as the domain) and stays encrypted on this PC, readable only by your Windows user. Everything else works without it.
Settings.ApiKey.Invalid: Invalid key: it is 32 characters from 0-9 and A-F, as Steam shows it.
Settings.Diff.Hint: The executable of a program that compares two files, for example
Settings.Diff.Hint.After: . When set, the overwritten files and "Find files" get a Diff button. Empty: no button.
Settings.Diff.Invalid: The compare program must be an existing .exe file.
